title: RunTestPayload
description: Payload for the RUN_TEST command (see contracts/enums/enums.yaml). Delivered to the device via GET /api/v1/devices/{device_id}/command and inflated by test-control immediately before the device's logger state transitions PREPARING -> RUNNING_TEST.

test_id.description: ULID-prefixed test identifier. Server-assigned. Recorded in header.json and joined onto every Parquet row.

server_host.description: Hostname or IP literal the UE connects to / sends to for every flow in this test. A single host per test; per-flow distinction is by port (see flow_bindings).

flow_bindings.description: Server-allocated port per flow, keyed by flow_id. test-control fills exactly one binding for every flow in test_plan.flows before sending RUN_TEST. The device joins binding.flow_id -> plan flow to learn where to connect/send.

logging_config_override.description: Optional per-test logging config. Replaces (not merges with) the device's currently effective LoggingConfig for the duration of this test. The server still enforces effective ⊆ capability (invariant 3) before sending.
